headline: Public hearings on two-lot subdivisions at 24 Worthley Road and 190 Hampstead Road.
summary: The meeting includes two two-lot subdivision reviews, one continued from October 7, 2026. It also includes a workshop on proposed Derry Zoning Ordinance changes to match recent State legislative amendments.
items: Escrow #26-37, Cafua Realty Trust CLXXIII, LLC

Other Business: SNHPC Housing Readiness Pilot Update by James Vayo
Public hearing, continued from October 7, 2026: Nottonson Family Revocable Trust, PID 12006, 24 Worthley Road, acceptance and review of two-lot subdivision
Public hearing: Richard J. Ward, PID 10007-001, 190 Hampstead Road, acceptance and review of two-lot subdivision
Workshop #2: Review of proposed changes to the Town of Derry Zoning Ordinance to comply with recent State legislative amendments
